tasks.label: NOVA: inspect environment
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; '--- versions ---'; foreach ($name in @('node','npm','git','gh','docker','podman','pnpm','corepack')) { $cmd=Get-Command $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($cmd) { & $name --version 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 1 } else { "$name : unavailable" } }; '--- git state ---'; git status --short --branch 2>&1; '--- gh auth ---'; gh auth status 2>&1
